# Nailfolio | Nail portfolio and client history for nail artists

> Nailfolio, the app for nail artists. Online nail portfolio with filters, a QR code in the salon, inspiration sessions from clients and a history of recent visits. Prepare for every appointment. Free to start.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/index.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/index.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Online nail portfolio and client history

Present your work in a gallery with color, style and length filters. Clients can send Inspiration Sessions and messages before a visit. Paid plans also include visit history.

- Free plan forever, no card
- 30-day Pro trial with a card
- 0% commission on clients

## Design selection, photos and client notes

- Photos from the web may require discussing the design’s scope
- A specific design can be hard to find among many posts
- Review notes on preferences and allergies before a visit

Before a visit, review the client’s selected inspiration and previous notes. Clients use filters in your gallery to narrow their photo selection.

In Nailfolio, review your gallery photos, Inspiration Sessions shared by the client and notes in their client card. Visit history is available on paid plans.

## Portfolio, client history and visit conversation, all in one place.

Use the gallery, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions and Messages. Client history access and gallery limits depend on your plan.

### Nail gallery with filters

Clients can combine color, style and length filters to find photos matching their choices.

### Client notes and history

Keep notes on allergies and preferences in the client card. Paid plans also let you review visit history.

### Connect with a client using a QR code

The client scans your QR code and signs in without a password. After you approve the connection request, they can access your full gallery.

### Inspiration Session before a visit

The client picks photos from your gallery, adds notes and shares the whole inspiration session. You see the plan before you start working.

### Fixed subscription fee

Nailfolio does not charge commission on clients. Paid plans have a fixed subscription fee.

### Messages with clients

Use Messages to communicate with connected clients and discuss details before a visit.

Always free for clients

### Add photos of your work

Add photos of completed designs and tag nail color, style and length. Tags enable gallery filtering.

### Show the QR code to your client

Show your QR code on your phone or in print. The client scans it, signs in and sends a connection request. Once you approve it, they can access your full gallery.

### The client filters and chooses

The client filters photos by color, style and length. They can like selected designs and share them in an Inspiration Session with notes.

## Nailfolio, social media and booking apps

One place for real designs, visit arrangements and your client's choice.

## Nailfolio for nail salon clients

Learn about QR connections, your stylist’s gallery and Inspiration Sessions before a visit.

## Got a team of nail artists?

Studio includes a salon gallery, full client history and a team list. See the salon page for the available features.

### Choose before the visit

Your client browses your gallery and sends selected designs in an inspiration session.

### Agree on the details

Messages and notes help you prepare for the appointment.

### Keep a visit record

A paid plan lets you save result photos and revisit your client’s history.

From choosing a design to documenting the result, each feature supports your work as a stylist.

## Questions people ask most

### What is Nailfolio?

Nailfolio is an app for nail stylists and their clients. It includes a work gallery with filters, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions and Messages. Paid plans also give stylists access to client visit history. The app works in a phone browser.

### How does Nailfolio differ from an Instagram gallery?

In Nailfolio, clients browse your work using color, style and length filters. Once connected, they can select photos and share an Inspiration Session with notes. Paid plans also include visit history.

### What does Free include?

Yes. You sign up without a card and start on the Free plan: 5 gallery photos, a QR code and basic filters, free forever. Every paid plan comes with a 30-day free trial: you add a card when the trial starts, and the subscription begins only after it ends (cancel anytime). Zero commission on your clients.

### What does the client get after scanning the QR code?

After signing in, the client sends a connection request. You confirm it with one tap, so you control access to your full gallery with filters for color, style and length. Once confirmed, the client browses your work, can like designs and send you an inspiration session before the visit.

### What about my photos: who owns them?

You retain the rights to your photos. Nailfolio does not sell them or use them in ads. The Nailfolio database is hosted in the European Union. You can deactivate your account and restore it within 90 days.

### How do I set up a portfolio?

Create an account, add photos and tag color, style and length. Then share your QR code with the client and approve their connection request.

# Nail Portfolio App for Nail Artists: Client History

> An online nail portfolio with filters and an in-salon QR code. Your client picks designs from your work, and before the visit you have her history and notes in one place. 0% commission.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/for-stylists/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/for-stylists.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/for-stylists.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Online nail portfolio and client history

Add photos of your work with color, style and length filters. Clients can share an Inspiration Session and message you before a visit. Paid plans also let you review their visit history.

- Free plan forever, no card
- 30-day Pro trial with a card
- Cancel before it ends, pay nothing

## Design selection and client notes before a visit

Before the client sits in the chair, she looks at your portfolio and picks a design for the visit.

**Problem:** A client shows a design from the internet that needs to be adapted to her nail length.
**Solution:** Show the client your work and narrow the choice with length, color and style filters.

**Problem:** On Instagram, finding one specific design in a flood of posts is hard.
**Solution:** In Nailfolio every photo has a color, length and style. Your client narrows the choice instead of scrolling through post after post.

**Problem:** Before the visit, photos from the web and earlier decisions are hard to find.
**Solution:** The client shares selected photos and notes in an Inspiration Session. You can review them before the visit.

## Nail portfolio, Inspiration Sessions and client history

Add your work to the gallery, receive clients’ choices before visits and keep notes in their client cards. History access depends on your plan.

### Nail gallery with filters

Tag photos by color, style, length and design details. Clients can use these tags to filter the gallery.

### Every client's history in one place

Notes and previous inspirations organize the conversation when a regular client returns for her next visit.

### Your QR code at the station

Show the client a QR code on your phone or in print. After signing in, they send a connection request. Confirm it to give them access to your full gallery.

### Inspiration Session before a visit

The client selects photos from your gallery, adds notes and shares an Inspiration Session before the visit.

Inspiration session

### Fixed fee, zero commission

Paid plans have a fixed subscription fee. Nailfolio does not charge commission on clients.

### Salon profile and team list

Studio includes a gallery on the salon account and a team list. Membership does not give stylists access to the salon gallery or data.

### Gallery setup checklist

In the Gallery Strength section you see your next steps: adding photos, completing your profile and connecting with your first client. That way you know what to do before you show your profile to clients.

### Messages with connected clients

Use Messages to communicate with connected clients. A phone number on your public profile is optional.

See the app from the inside

## How to set up a nail portfolio in Nailfolio

Add photos, tag them and share your QR code. You can then review the choices of connected clients.

### Add your first work

Choose photos that show range: nude, french, color, short, long and detailed designs.

Step 1: photos of your work

### Tag color, style and length

Thanks to tags, the client narrows down her choice faster herself, instead of scrolling through a folder of photos.

Filters help the client decide

### Show the QR code to your client

The client can enter your gallery during the visit, like designs and come back to them before the next one.

Gallery access after connection approval

### Return to client history

At the next visit you see previous choices, notes and shared inspiration.

Choices and notes from previous visits

### Choose before the visit

Your client browses your gallery and sends selected designs in an inspiration session.

### Agree on the details

Messages and notes help you prepare for the appointment.

### Keep a visit record

A paid plan lets you save result photos and revisit your client’s history.

- Database hosted in the EU
- Stripe
- Private galleries
- Cancel anytime
- 0% commission from clients
- 100% you own your photos
- 3 languages: Polish, English and German

From choosing a design to documenting the result, each feature supports your work as a stylist.

## Stylists' most common questions

### How does Nailfolio differ from Instagram?

In Nailfolio, clients browse your work using color, style and length filters. They can select photos, add notes and share an Inspiration Session. Paid plans also include client history.

### How does a client access the gallery?

The client scans your QR code, signs in with Google or an email link and sends a connection request. Once you accept it, they can access the full gallery. The public profile with selected work is available without signing in.

### How do Free and Pro differ?

Free has no charge or time limit. Pro includes unlimited gallery photos and connected clients, plus visit history from the last 90 days. Inspiration Sessions are available on every plan. See pricing for prices and other limits.

### How does the Pro trial work?

The Pro trial lasts 30 days and requires a card. Cancel in the Stripe portal before it ends to avoid a charge. Otherwise, a paid subscription starts after the trial.

### I already use Booksy/Fresha. Is Nailfolio an alternative?

Nailfolio is for presenting your work and preparing for visits. Booksy and Fresha offer appointment booking, which Nailfolio does not provide. You can use these tools alongside each other. Compare Booksy, Fresha and Instagram.

### What happens to my photos if I cancel my subscription?

Photos remain in your account. When the paid plan ends, Free limits apply: up to 3 public profile pins, 5 photos and 2 connected clients. Above a limit, you cannot add new photos or connections. Connected clients retain gallery access.

### Does a client have to install an app to see my entire gallery?

The public profile with selected work is available without an account. The full gallery, QR connection and Inspiration Sessions require a free client account. Nailfolio works in a phone browser, with no installation needed.

### I'm switching from another app. Will you help me import my gallery?

Contact support before moving your gallery to discuss importing it. Available assistance depends on the format of your photos and data from the previous app.

### Will my client see that I pay for an app?

No. Clients cannot access your subscription, invoices or payment settings.

### Can I message my clients in the app?

Yes. In the Messages tab you reply to a client you're connected with, without sharing a private number or Messenger. The phone number on your public profile is optional, you add it only if you want to.

### I don't have a fixed station, I work at my clients' homes, is this for me?

Yes. You can show the QR code on your phone wherever you work. After the connection is confirmed, the client can access your gallery.

# Nail Designs From Your Stylist's Portfolio, Set Before Your Visit

> Scan your stylist's QR code, choose nail designs from her portfolio, set them in an inspiration session and message her before your visit. Nailfolio is free for clients.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/for-clients/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/for-clients.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/for-clients.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Nail designs from your stylist

In Nailfolio you pick looks from your stylist's gallery, build them into an inspiration session with a note and send it before your visit. Once the two of you are connected, you message her in Messages. Start by scanning a QR code at the salon.

- Always free for clients, no card
- QR at the station
- Photos of your stylist’s work

## How to prepare inspiration before a visit

Choose photos from your stylist’s gallery, add notes and share an Inspiration Session. Your stylist can review it before you meet.

### Connect with a stylist using a QR code

Scan the QR code at the station, your stylist confirms, and her gallery opens on your phone.

At the salon

### Choose photos from your stylist’s gallery

Filters work together: pick color, style and length at the same time. You only see the designs that match your idea.

Before deciding

### Share an Inspiration Session with notes

Your stylist sees your chosen photos with notes and can prepare in advance.

Before your next visit

### Browse your stylist’s latest work

Visit your stylist’s gallery to view newly added photos.

After the visit

## Your stylist’s gallery, liked designs and Inspiration Sessions

After connecting with your stylist, browse their gallery, choose designs and share Inspiration Sessions. You can also use Messages. Client accounts are free.

### A nail gallery with color, style and length filters

Browse your stylist’s work and combine color, style and nail length filters.

Results include designs that match all selected filters.

### Your stylist's full gallery on your phone

You'll see a QR code at your stylist's station. Scan it with your phone and sign in without a password, and once your stylist confirms, her full gallery is yours.

### Your collection of favorite designs

Like the designs from your stylist's gallery and build a collection before your visit. You can return to it from any phone. Only you can see this collection until you share it with your stylist.

Your collection stays with you even when your stylist adds new work. Pick up where you left off on any phone.

### Your stylists in one place

Like the stylist profiles you want to revisit. Find them in your collection and check their public profiles for new work.

### Inspiration Session with photos and notes

Select photos and add notes in an Inspiration Session. Once shared, your stylist can review your choices before the visit.

Your stylist opens one session and sees everything at once: photos, notes and order.

### Messages to your stylist

After your connection is confirmed, you can contact your stylist in Messages.

Clients always use Nailfolio for free.

### Scan the QR code at the nail salon

Scan the code, sign in and send a connection request. Once the stylist approves it, you can access their gallery.

### Filter nail designs by color, style and length

Filters for color, style and length narrow your choice. You can like the designs you pick and add a short note.

### Share the inspiration session with your stylist

Your stylist can view selected photos and notes. A shared session is available for 7 days.

Inspiration sessions stay live for 7 days after sharing.

## Nail designs from your stylist’s gallery

Browse completed designs and filter by color, length and style. Share selected photos with your stylist before the visit.

- Fuchsia aura with stars
- Tortoiseshell with gold foil
- Cobalt French with flowers
- Blue and purple chrome

## Client account privacy

Nailfolio stores information needed to operate your account and connections with stylists. It does not sell data, display ads or track you across apps.

- Nailfolio does not sell data to third parties
- No ads, no cross-app tracking
- Deactivate your account with one tap, and restore it within 90 days

## Data and payments in Nailfolio

Client accounts are free and require no card. Nailfolio does not display ads. The database is hosted in the European Union.

- No hidden fees
- No credit card, no payments
- Encrypted connection
- Database hosted in the EU
- Private galleries
- No ads, no data selling

## How to invite your stylist to Nailfolio

Send your stylist a Nailfolio link. They can create a free account, no card required, and you come back to their gallery before your next visit.

# Nail Salon Portfolio, Dashboard and Client History

> Nailfolio Studio: nail salon gallery, full client history and a team list with invitations. Check features, limits and salon account access rules.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/for-studios/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/for-studios.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/for-studios.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Nail salon portfolio and team list

Studio lets you maintain a salon gallery, record client history and present a team list. An invited stylist must accept membership. Joining the team does not give them access to the salon gallery or account data.

- Whole team included
- Full client history on the account
- Owner dashboard
- Clients always free

- 10 accounts included (whole team)
- 0% commission from clients
- 30 days free trial, cancel anytime

## Plans for solo stylists, salons and larger teams

Pro and Pro Marka are for solo stylists. Studio covers a salon team of up to 10 accounts. Scale is agreed individually.

### You are opening your first station

Pro includes an unlimited gallery and client visit history from the last 90 days. It is designed for solo stylists.

Start on the Pro plan

### You are running a team under one brand

The owner manages the salon gallery and team list. Stylists confirm membership through an invitation, without access to the salon account’s gallery or data.

Studio plan for growing teams

### You are scaling to more locations

For larger teams, multiple locations or additional features, contact support to discuss Scale. Implementation and support are defined in an individual offer.

Scale: individual offer

## Owner account and team membership

The owner manages the salon account. The team list confirms membership and shows stylists’ profiles after invitation acceptance. It does not share the salon gallery or data with them.

## Salon gallery, client history and team list

Studio includes full client history and a team list. Inviting a stylist confirms their membership; it does not share access to the salon account.

### Gallery on the salon account

The owner adds work photos to the salon account’s gallery. Team membership does not give a stylist access to that gallery.

### Salon team list

After accepting an invitation, the stylist appears on the team list with their name and profile photo.

### Inspiration Sessions on the salon account

A connected client can share an Inspiration Session with the salon account. Team membership does not give a stylist access to those sessions.

### Owner's panel: the whole salon in one view

Use the owner dashboard to send invitations, check their status and remove people from the team list.

## Three steps to launch your nail salon on Nailfolio

Create a Studio account, add photos to the gallery and invite stylists to the team list. Then connect the account with clients using the QR code.

### Create a Studio account and invite your nail artists

Choose Studio. Invite stylists who already have a Nailfolio account. After accepting, their name and photo appear on the team list.

### Add photos to the salon gallery

As the owner, add photos, tag them and select work for the public profile. Invited stylists do not gain access to the salon account’s gallery.

### Clients scan the QR at the salon

Show the client the salon account’s QR code. After signing in, they send a connection request. Once you approve it, they can browse the gallery and share Inspiration Sessions.

## Portfolio, inspiration and client communication history

The salon account stores photos, Inspiration Sessions, notes and Messages. The team list is a separate feature and does not give stylists access to this data.

### Client with a ready inspiration session

Review photos and notes shared by the client before the visit.

### Consistent salon gallery

The salon profile presents photos added by the account owner.

### Client history on the salon account

Visit history and conversations are stored on the salon account. Invited stylists have their own accounts and do not gain access to salon data.

## Salon data, photo rights and payments

- 0% commission from clients
- 100% photo ownership: stays with you even after cancellation
- EU Nailfolio database location
- Stripe payments through Stripe

Nailfolio is developed in Kraków.

## Questions about Studio plan

### How many stylists can I add?

Studio includes the owner and up to 9 people on the team list, with no per-seat fees. A stylist must have their own account and accept the invitation. Membership does not provide access to the salon gallery or data.

### Can clients see who did which design?

The team list shows the stylist’s name and photo after invitation acceptance. The salon gallery is managed from the owner’s account.

### Can invited stylists access the salon gallery?

No. Accepting an invitation confirms membership and allows the stylist’s name and photo to appear on the team list. It does not grant access to the salon account or gallery.

### How much does the Studio plan cost?

See pricing for the current price. Studio includes up to 10 team accounts, the owner dashboard and a shared salon profile. For a larger team, contact support about Scale.

### Can I cancel the Studio plan?

Yes, at any time from your account. After cancellation your photos, clients and session history remain: you move to the Free plan.

### What happens when a nail artist leaves the team?

The owner can remove a stylist from the team list. This does not delete their separate Nailfolio account. Data stored on the salon account remains there.

### Can I test Studio before purchasing?

Studio has a 30-day trial with a card required at activation. You can test salon account features and team invitations. Joining the team does not give a stylist access to salon data.

### What about a large team or several locations?

Studio covers one location and up to 10 accounts with no per-seat fees. Contact support to discuss Scale and an individual offer for larger teams or multiple locations.

### Can stylists see messages on the salon account?

No. Team membership does not share Messages from the salon account. The owner sees conversations on their own account, not private conversations from separate stylist accounts.

# Pricing, Free, Pro, Pro Marka and Studio

> Nailfolio pricing: Free with 5 photos, Pro with an unlimited gallery and 90-day visit history, Pro Marka with full history and Studio with team accounts. Compare features and limits.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/pricing/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/pricing.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/pricing.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Nailfolio pricing and plan comparison

Nailfolio connects your portfolio with how you prepare for every visit: your client's gallery picks, the conversation and her recent visit history, all in one place.

- 30 days of Pro free
- Fixed fee, 0% commission on clients
- Free plan forever, no card

| Plan | Best for |
| --- | --- |
| Free | demo: 5 photos, 2 clients, no card |
| Pro | solo stylist, unlimited gallery |
| Pro Marka | Pro + lifelong client history and brand color |
| Studio | salon, whole team included, up to 10 accounts, no per-seat fees |
| Scale | salon chains, SLA, custom pricing |

Current prices (PLN, billed monthly or yearly with a 20% discount): https://nailfolio.app/en/pricing. Every paid plan starts with a 30-day trial (card required at activation, Stripe). The Free plan needs no card. Clients always use Nailfolio for free.

## Features available during the Pro trial

- Unlimited gallery photos instead of 5 on the Free plan
- Unlimited connected clients instead of 2 on the Free plan
- Inspiration session: the client picks photos with notes, and you have the full set before the visit.
- Your own profile link, e.g. nailfolio.app/u/anna-nails, to show every client.

Use Pro features for 30 days. The trial requires a card. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid a charge.

A paid subscription starts after 30 days unless canceled beforehand. Free has no charge or time limit and requires no card.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I change my plan at any time?

Yes. A higher plan takes effect immediately: e.g. switching from Pro to Pro Marka mid-month, we charge only the prorated difference. A lower plan takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

### What happens after the 30 free days of Pro?

After 30 days the subscription starts automatically at your chosen plan. You get a reminder email 7 days before the trial ends. If you cancel during the trial you pay nothing, and your photos and data stay. You can stay on the Free plan for as long as you like.

### Which payment methods are available?

Cards (Visa, Mastercard) and BLIK via Stripe. Card details never touch Nailfolio servers.

### Do clients pay anything?

No. The client scans the QR code and sends a connection request. Once the stylist accepts it, the client sees the full gallery and shares inspiration sessions. The stylist controls access, and the client uses the gallery and inspiration sessions at no cost.

### How do the 30 free days of Pro work?

A new stylist account starts on the Free plan, no card. Every paid plan comes with a 30-day free trial: you add a card at the start, and the subscription begins only after the trial. Your photos and data stay either way.

### Are my photos and client data secure?

The app connection is encrypted, the Nailfolio database is hosted in the European Union and Stripe handles payments. See the privacy policy for information about external services.

### What happens to my photos after I cancel?

Photos remain in your account. When the paid plan ends, Free limits apply: the public profile shows up to 3 pinned designs, and adding photos beyond 5 is blocked. Connected clients retain gallery access.

### Do I get a VAT invoice?

Yes. At checkout you turn on "Company VAT invoice" and enter your company name, address and tax ID. From then on a VAT invoice with your details appears on every payment, in your billing panel. It covers Polish sole proprietorship, civil partnership and limited company.

# Nailfolio, Booksy, Fresha and Instagram: comparison of uses

> Compare Nailfolio with booking apps and social media. Nail gallery, Inspiration Sessions, Messages and client history.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/compare/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/compare.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/compare.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## How is Nailfolio different from Booksy, Fresha and Instagram?

Compare booking apps, social media and Nailfolio by purpose. In Nailfolio, you maintain a work gallery and visit history and receive Inspiration Sessions with notes from clients.

## Comparison of features and purpose

Bookings, photo publishing and visit preparation serve different purposes.

| | Nailfolio | Booksy / Fresha | Instagram / Pinterest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| What it's for | Visit prep and client history | Bookings and the appointment calendar | Reach and online presence |
| What your client sees | Your gallery with color, style and length filters | Time slots and services with a price list | Posts, reels and photos |
| Client history | Notes, messages, inspiration sessions and visit history | Appointment history | No dedicated client card |
| Cost for you | Free plan or paid subscription, no commission from clients | A subscription, and with some tools a commission on every new client acquired through their platform | Free account, optional paid advertising |

You can use a booking app alongside Nailfolio. Add a booking link to your public profile. In Nailfolio, clients choose photos for Inspiration Sessions and stylists maintain visit history.

## Nailfolio and appointment booking apps

- Booksy is used for bookings and appointment calendars. Nailfolio is used to present work, choose inspiration and maintain client history. Bookings take place outside Nailfolio.
- A client can book through Booksy, then choose photos from your Nailfolio gallery. After connecting, they can share an Inspiration Session and discuss details in Messages.

Nailfolio does not broker bookings or charge commission from clients.

## Nailfolio and sharing work on Instagram

- On Instagram, you publish photos, reels and stories and communicate with followers.
- In Nailfolio, clients filter photos of your work by nail color, style and length. They choose photos for an Inspiration Session, which they can share before a visit.

You can add your Nailfolio public profile link to Instagram.

## Pinterest photos and a gallery of your own work

- On Pinterest, clients browse inspiration from many creators. Before creating a design, discuss how it fits the nail length and shape and the available materials.
- In Nailfolio, clients choose from your previous work. They can share selected photos and notes in an Inspiration Session to discuss the details before a visit.

## Gallery and preparation for a visit

In Nailfolio, you review photos chosen by the client, communicate in Messages and record visit history in the client card.

## The most common questions about Nailfolio next to other tools

### Does Nailfolio replace Booksy?

No. Bookings take place outside Nailfolio. In Nailfolio, you maintain a gallery, receive Inspiration Sessions and record client history. You can add a booking link to your public profile.

### Do I have to give up Instagram?

No. You can continue publishing work on Instagram and add a link to Nailfolio. In Nailfolio, clients browse a filtered gallery and choose photos for Inspiration Sessions.

### How is Nailfolio different from Pinterest?

Pinterest includes photos by many creators. In Nailfolio, clients browse their stylist’s work, filter it and choose photos for Inspiration Sessions.

### How much does it cost compared to Booksy or Fresha?

You start for free: 5 photos, 2 connected clients and no card. Pro is a flat monthly fee with no commission, you'll find the current price on the pricing page. Booking apps usually require a subscription, and some also take a commission on every new client acquired through their platform.

### What can I use Nailfolio for alongside other apps?

In Nailfolio, you can keep your work gallery, photos chosen by clients before a visit, messages and visit history. Clients share Inspiration Sessions after connecting with a stylist.

### Can I import photos from Instagram or Booksy?

Use the contact form before moving photos. You can ask for help preparing the gallery and assigning colors and features to photos.

# About Nailfolio: nail portfolio and client history for stylists

> The nail portfolio app for nail stylists: a gallery of your work, visit prep through inspiration sessions and a history of recent visits with clients, with no commission.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/about/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/about.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/about.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## About Nailfolio: an app for nail stylists and clients

Nailfolio is developed in Kraków. Use the app to present your work, receive Inspiration Sessions from clients and record visit history.

A nail portfolio and client history for independent stylists and salons.

In Nailfolio, you maintain a public profile, work gallery and client cards. Clients choose photos for Inspiration Sessions and share them before a visit.

## Why Nailfolio was created

- Photos chosen before a visit help you discuss color, length and nail art. When a client chooses from their stylist’s work, the conversation can refer to designs the stylist has already created.
- Social media posts help you present your work and connect with an audience. Preparing a nail design also involves photo filters, notes and the individual client’s visit history.
- Nailfolio combines these features in an app for nail stylists. Clients browse a gallery with color, style and length filters and share Inspiration Sessions after connecting with a stylist. The stylist can review the selected photos and record notes and visit history in the client card.

Work gallery, inspiration and visit history.

## Gallery, mobile access and data

Features and terms of using Nailfolio.

### Work gallery for nail stylists

The gallery has nail color, style and length filters. A QR code connects a client with a stylist. Once the connection is confirmed, the client can choose photos for an Inspiration Session.

### Photos and QR code on your phone

Add a photo from your phone, select the design’s colors and features, then publish it in your gallery. Show the QR code on your screen or print it.

### Photo ownership and data storage

The app database is stored in the European Union. Nailfolio does not sell data or use marketing cookies. You retain ownership of your photos regardless of your plan.

## Nailfolio development milestones

From the first sketches to the gallery, QR connections and client cards.

### 2024: First product sketches

The first app sketches covered a gallery of the stylist’s work and choosing inspiration before a visit.

### Early 2025: First prototype and tests

The first version included gallery filters and a QR code. Three salons in Kraków tested how clients connect with stylists.

### Summer 2025: Polish version, policies and hosting

Preparation of the Polish language version, terms of service, privacy policy and EU data hosting.

### Q3 2026: Stylist account registration

Nail stylists can create a free account and use the gallery and QR code. Client visit history is available on paid plans.

### Next stage: Further markets and the mobile app

Development plans include Czech, German-speaking and English-speaking markets and a mobile app.

## Photos, fees and languages

- 100% ownership of your photos
- 0% commission from your clients
- 3 languages: Polish, English, German

The first nail stylists from Krakow and Warsaw were testing Nailfolio before the launch.

- Company in Kraków
- Built with nail stylists from Poland
- Database in the EU
- Independent, no investors

### Who is behind Nailfolio?

Nailfolio is an independently developed product from Kraków. Feedback from nail stylists informs its development.

### How is Nailfolio different from Booksy?

Booksy is a platform for booking appointments. Nailfolio is a nail portfolio with client history: color, style and length filters, a QR code at the salon, and Inspiration Sessions from clients. They solve different problems, so the two work well side by side.

### How is Nailfolio development funded?

Nailfolio is developed without external investors. Paid plans fund further app development.

### Where is the data stored?

The app database is stored in the EU. Cloudinary handles photos and Stripe handles payments. Some providers also process data outside the EU; see the privacy policy for details. Nailfolio does not sell data or use marketing cookies.

### Which languages is Nailfolio available in?

Nailfolio is available in Polish, English and German. Planned further markets include Czechia.

You will receive a reply within one business day.

### What should I include in a bug report?

Describe what is not working and when the error occurs. Include your phone model and browser. If possible, attach a screenshot to your email.

Contact is available in Polish, English and German. The reply will use the language of your message.

Select “Plans and pricing” or email kontakt@nailfolio.app. You can also ask about Studio and Scale plans there.

Select “Partnership or collaboration” or email kontakt@nailfolio.app to ask about a custom Scale offer.

Nailfolio is an independently developed app from Kraków.

# Help Center and FAQ

> Nailfolio Help Center: instructions for the gallery, QR code, Inspiration Sessions, Messages, accounts and subscriptions.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/help-center/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/help-center.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/help-center.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Nailfolio Help Center

Find answers about your gallery, QR code, inspiration sessions, messages, client history and your account.

## How to connect with a stylist and share inspiration

### Scan QR code

Scan your stylist’s QR code and sign in to send a connection request.

### Browse the gallery

Once your stylist confirms the connection, you can browse all her work, not just her public photos.

### Prepare your session

Like designs, add notes and share your inspiration session with your stylist before the visit.

### Discuss the design before your visit

After you share the session, your stylist can see the selected photos and notes. Discuss the details in Messages.

## General

### What is Nailfolio?

Nailfolio is an app for nail stylists and their clients. It includes a gallery with filters, QR connections, Inspiration Sessions, Messages and a client card with visit history.

### Is Nailfolio free?

The Free plan for stylists has no charge. Paid plans offer higher limits and additional features. Client accounts are free.

### How do I get started with Nailfolio?

Open nailfolio.app in your phone’s browser on Android or iPhone. Sign in with Google or a link sent by email.

### What devices does Nailfolio work on?

All app features are available in your phone’s browser on Android and iPhone. Nailfolio has no separate desktop app. The Android app is in preparation.

### Is my data safe?

Connections to the app are encrypted and the database is stored in the EU. Stripe handles payments. See the privacy policy for information about service providers and data processing.

### How can I contact Nailfolio?

Use the contact form, email kontakt@nailfolio.app or send a message on Instagram (@nailfolio).

### How do I sign in if there's no password?

Sign in with Google or a link sent by email. To receive a link, enter your email address, then open the link in the message. No password is required.

### The magic sign-in link isn't arriving, what should I do?

Check your spam and promotions folders. The login link is valid for one hour; request a new one after that time. You can also sign in with Google. If the problem persists, use the contact form and provide the email address used to sign in.

### Can I sign in on several devices at once?

Yes. The same account works on all your devices at the same time. Sign in the same way (magic link to the same email or Google). You can check and sign out active sessions in Account → Signed-in devices.

### How do I switch between the nail artist and client roles?

You can have a stylist and a client account at the same time. Go to Account → Settings → Switch role. You keep all your data, each role has its own galleries and settings.

### The app isn't working or loads slowly, what should I do?

Close and reopen Nailfolio, then check your internet connection. If the problem persists, submit a report with your phone model, operating system and a description of the error.

### How do I report an inappropriate photo?

On the photo, open the menu (three dots) and choose Report, then select a reason. An admin reviews the report within 48 hours on business days and makes a decision. You'll receive a notification about the outcome.

## For nail artists

### How do I add nail photos to my Nailfolio gallery?

Open the app, go to the Add tab, take a photo or choose from your gallery, tag colors and features, then publish.

### What are pinned photos?

Pinned photos are your best work, displayed at the top of your public profile. The number of pins depends on your plan.

### How do I generate a QR code for clients?

You have one permanent code: you will find it on the Connection screen, you can show it to a client on your phone or print it and hang it at your station. The client scans it with her camera, lands on your profile and sends a connection request, which you accept with one tap.

### How can a client send me inspiration before the visit?

The client creates an inspiration session: she picks photos from your gallery, adds notes and shares the whole collection with you in one click. You see it in the Session Clipboard in the app.

### How do I change my pricing plan?

Go to Account → Subscription. You can change your plan at any time: a higher plan takes effect immediately, a lower one at the end of the billing period.

### Can I add nail artist accounts?

Studio includes a salon team roster and invitations to existing stylist accounts. An invited stylist accepts or declines the invitation. The plan covers up to 10 accounts including the owner, with no per-seat fees. Team membership does not currently provide access to the salon account or gallery.

### What happens to my photos when I downgrade?

Your photos stay in your account and nothing is hidden: connected clients still see your whole gallery, and on the Free plan your public profile shows up to 3 pinned works. Free only stops you from adding photos beyond 5. Nothing is deleted without your decision.

### How does subscription auto-renewal work?

After the 30-day trial the subscription renews automatically. A reminder arrives 7 days before the charge, so you have time to cancel or change plans. You cancel from your account, no extra email needed.

### How do I cancel my subscription?

Go to Account → Subscription → Manage subscription. The Stripe billing portal opens, where you can cancel your subscription. After cancelling you return to the Free plan and keep your account and data. Connected clients still see all your photos, and Free only stops you from adding new ones beyond the limit.

### My payment didn't go through, what should I do?

Check that your card is active and has sufficient funds. Go to Account → Subscription → Manage subscription and update your card details. Stripe will automatically retry the payment. If the problem persists, use the contact form.

### I'd like a refund, how does that work?

During the 30-day Pro trial, you can cancel without a charge. If a payment has already been taken, submit a request within 14 days. After the request is reviewed, you will receive a reply about the refund. Any approved refund is credited to your card within 5 to 10 business days.

### A staff member has left, how do I revoke their access?

Go to Account → Team, select the staff member and click Remove. The person is removed from the salon team roster. Their private Nailfolio account remains available.

### How do I reply to a client in the app?

Open the Messages tab, there you'll see conversations with clients you're connected with.

### Do I have to add a phone number to my profile?

No, the field is optional. If you fill it in, clients will see it on your public profile.

## For clients

### How do I find a nail artist?

Scan the QR code at your stylist's salon and sign in to the app with a Google account or a link sent by email. That sends a connection request. Your stylist controls access: once she confirms the request with a single tap, you'll see her whole gallery. Then you can filter the work by colors and features to quickly find what you are looking for.

### Can I like nail artists?

Yes! Click Like nail artist on her profile. You'll find her in your collection afterwards.

### How do I like a design?

Click the heart icon on a photo in the gallery. Your liked designs are in the Your collection tab.

### What is connecting with a nail artist?

Connecting with your nail artist is a quick way to see her full gallery, put together an inspiration session before your visit and message her in Messages. Scan her QR code at the salon and, once she confirms the connection, you have access to all of it.

### Do I have to pay for an account?

No! A client account is completely free. You can browse galleries and like any design or nail artist, with no charges at all.

### How do I delete my account?

Go to Account → Settings → Delete account. The account is deactivated and your data is stored safely. You have 90 days to change your mind: just log in again and restore your account with one click. Permanent data erasure is available any time on request (GDPR Art. 17) by writing to privacy@nailfolio.app.

### Does the artist’s code expire or work only once?

No. Your nail artist has one permanent code: the same one hangs at the station and shows on her screen. Scan it with your regular camera, you will land on her profile and send a connection request, and she accepts it with one tap.

### I see a message that I'm already connected with this nail artist. What does that mean?

It means you already have an active connection with this stylist and don't need to scan their code again. Open Dashboard → Connected stylists to see their full gallery. You can have up to 3 connected stylists at a time.

### My photo has disappeared from the gallery, why?

A photo may be hidden if it violates the content rules, for example by showing personal data, faces or content unrelated to nails. The reason for the decision is sent by email. To appeal, reply to that message. You will receive a reply to the appeal within 48 hours.

### Can I message my stylist?

Yes, in the Messages tab, once you're connected.

## Technical

### What photo formats are supported?

Nailfolio supports JPG, PNG and WEBP formats. Maximum file size is 10 MB. Photos are automatically optimised.

### How does color tagging work?

When adding a photo you choose colors from the palette available in the app. You can select multiple colors for one photo.

### Is data encrypted?

Connections to the app are encrypted. The database is stored in the European Union.

### What are style features?

Features are tags describing techniques, effects and styles, e.g. French, Ombre, Chrome, Floral. The app has a set of predefined features in four categories.

### How do gallery filters work?

In a stylist's gallery you filter photos by color, style and nail length. The filters combine, and results update instantly.

### Does Nailfolio have an API?

Nailfolio does not offer a public API. Submit integration questions using the contact form.

### Does Nailfolio work offline?

The gallery and Inspiration Sessions require an internet connection. Nailfolio has no offline mode.

## App support contact

If you have not found an answer, describe your question in the contact form or send an email.

---

# Nailfolio on your phone: nail portfolio and client history

> Use Nailfolio in your phone’s browser: nail gallery, Inspiration Sessions, Messages and client history. Available on Android and iPhone.

HTML version of this page: https://nailfolio.app/en/get-app/ | Markdown mirrors: PL https://nailfolio.app/get-app.md, DE https://nailfolio.app/de/get-app.md | LLM index: https://nailfolio.app/llms.txt

## Nailfolio on your phone: nail portfolio and client history

Access your work gallery, Inspiration Sessions and visit history in your phone’s browser. The Android app will be available on Google Play.

## Gallery, Inspiration Sessions and client history

The stylist maintains a work gallery and visit history. A connected client chooses photos for an Inspiration Session and shares it before the visit.

### Adding nail design photos

Add a nail design photo and select its color, style and nail length. Once published, the photo is available in your gallery.

For nail artists

### Connecting with a stylist via QR code

The client scans the QR code, signs in with Google or an email link and sends a connection request. The stylist confirms the request to give access to the full gallery.

For nail artists and clients

### Color, style, and length filters

Select a nail color, style and length. The gallery displays photos matching the selected criteria.

For clients

### Inspiration Sessions before a visit

The client chooses gallery photos, adds notes and shares an Inspiration Session with the stylist. The stylist sees it in the Session Clipboard. A shared session stays active for 7 days.

For nail artists and clients

### Works on your phone and tablet

Use your phone or tablet. Your gallery and data sync automatically.

For nail artists

### Messages with connected clients

In Messages, you communicate with connected clients. You can also open a conversation from the client card.

For stylists and clients

## How Nailfolio works in the nail salon

Create an account, add photos or connect with a stylist, then prepare an Inspiration Session.

### Create an account

Open nailfolio.app in your phone’s browser. Sign in with Google or a link sent by email.

### Pick your role

On a stylist account, add photos and select colors and features. On a client account, scan the QR code and send a connection request to browse the full gallery once confirmed.

### Share an Inspiration Session

The client chooses gallery photos and shares an Inspiration Session. The stylist can review the photos and notes before the visit.

- No ads in the app
- Access in your phone’s browser
- No cross-app tracking
- Database stored in the EU

### When will the app be on Google Play, and how do I start today?

Nailfolio is available in your phone’s browser on Android and iPhone. The Android app is being prepared for publication on Google Play. A native iOS app is not currently available.

### Will the app be free?

Clients always use it for free, with no card and no other fees. Stylists start on the Free plan, also with no card and no time limit. When they need more, they can choose Pro, Pro Marka or Studio. I price the Scale plan individually. Pro, Pro Marka and Studio come with a 30-day trial that requires a card. The subscription starts once the trial ends.

### Does the app work without internet?

Features such as the gallery and Inspiration Sessions require an internet connection. Nailfolio has no offline mode.

### Does the app collect data for advertising?

Nailfolio does not use marketing cookies or advertising pixels and does not share data with advertisers. You can turn off analytics in the cookie banner. The app database is stored in the EU. Information about service providers and data processing is in the privacy policy.

### Which devices are supported?

Nailfolio works straight away in the browser on any phone. The Android app (version 10 or newer) is coming to Google Play soon.

### Does the client have to install the app?

Clients can use Nailfolio in their phone’s browser. An account is needed for likes and Inspiration Sessions, and a confirmed connection with the stylist gives access to the full gallery. Sign-in uses Google or an email link. The stylist’s public profile is available without an account.

### Can I use Nailfolio as a client, without a stylist account?

Yes. Nailfolio lets you have two accounts at once: you can be a stylist running your portfolio and a client of another stylist. The accounts are separate, each with its own history and inspiration sessions.

### What happens when I change my phone?

You sign in by email on the new device, and all your data (gallery, clients, inspiration sessions) is right there in the cloud. You can stay signed in on several devices at once, for example your phone and a tablet in the salon.
